pinning.Name: Pinning
pinning.Hint: When on, each pinned player sees the scene their pinned character's token is on, and GM scene activation and pulls do not move them. Moving the token moves the player. Turning it on checks that every pinned character has exactly one token.

Notify.AuditOk: Pinning on: all {n} pins have one token.

Audit.NoActor: {user} is pinned to a deleted actor
Audit.GmUser: {user} is a GM and is pinned to {actor}
Audit.NotOwner: {user} cannot observe {actor}: their view follows a token they get no vision from
